mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates and reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a continuous signal without threshold activation.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is above the 75th percentile is not negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) fall below their 12-month moving averages, it indicates weakening consumer demand and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST and RSAFS both below 12mo_MA) produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression of SPX returns on HOUST and RSAFS is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals strong economic conditions and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it indicates a weakening economy and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Lower housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This is a continuous signal without threshold activation.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST level and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 5-day return when HOUST is below the 25th percentile is not negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% and the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 305.0, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS>4.5% AND CPIAUCSL>305.0) produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression of SPX returns on FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This is a continuous signal without threshold activation.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO level and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 5-day return when INDPRO is above the 75th percentile is not positive (t-test p>0.05).
